summary: Revised implementation plan for the Community Spots management feature. Incorporates the existing logActivity helper and field shape (adminName, adminEmail, action, timestamp, details), explicit field fallbacks (title -> name, location.lat/lng -> latitude/longitude, photoUrls -> [], approvedByAdmin -> false), dual-collection approval writes ({ status: 'approved', active: true, approvedByAdmin: true } via updateDoc/merge), strict isolation of Danger Zones, rules, and login code, test suite details, and steps to test with the two pending spots.
